title: Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients Germany's largest lender now holds bitcoin, ether and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe, but it has not named any customers or disclosed fees. This post Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
